name: SnoopTrade API
description: FastAPI backend using your existing MongoDB Atlas cluster. One Basic dyno costs $7/month before student credits.

MONGODB_URI.description: Atlas Drivers connection string for the existing users, stock_data and sec_data databases. Enter it only in Heroku.

FRONTEND_URL.description: Your frontend's HTTPS origin, without a trailing slash.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Existing Google OAuth web client ID. Optional for email/password login.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS.description: Optional additional Google OAuth client IDs for mobile, separated by commas.

JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: Generated signing key. Reuse the existing key before cutover if you need to preserve current sessions.

ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Generated key protecting admin and external cron endpoints.
